subject: Lumina Health - committed usage tiers and custom per-token proposal
messages:
From: Emily Cho <e.cho@luminahealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Inquiry: committed tiers & potential custom per-token rate

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking the time on the call earlier. As mentioned, Lumina is evaluating using Redwood for our clinical summarization pipeline. We expect a steady-state of ~30B tokens/month by Q2, with higher bursts in onboarding.

A few asks from procurement:
- Can you outline the committed-tier discounts for the hosted API (per-token) and how tiers step down at higher volumes?
- Is there flexibility for a custom rate for a 12-month commit (we're targeting $X/mo spend but need a per-token unit price)?
- Any minimum spend or ramp schedule required for custom pricing?

Procurement will need a quote and an outline of approvals if we require a rate-card exception. Can you also share a sample SOW and a ballpark pro forma?

Best,
Emily Cho
Senior Procurement Manager
Lumina Health
procurement@luminahealth.com

Attachment: Lumina_RFP_20261129.pdf (see stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Cho <e.cho@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Alex Park <a.park@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: committed tiers & potential custom per-token rate

Hi Emily — appreciate the clear requirements. I've attached a draft SOW and a simple pricing workbook (pricing_calc_lumina.xlsx) with three scenarios: conservative ramp, target ramp (~30B tokens/mo), and upside. High level: our standard rate card applies up to 10B tokens/month with published step discounts; above that we offer tiered commit pricing but large-volume customers typically request a custom band.

Notes from our side:
- Standard list: $0.0006 per token at baseline (no commit) with published discounts at 2B, 5B, 10B thresholds.
- For the volumes you described, a custom committed unit price in the $0.00035–0.00045 range is plausible with a 12-mo commit and a revenue-minimum guarantee.
- To proceed with a non-rate-card price we need internal approval — I'll loop in Pricing/Finance and Sales leadership.

I've included a draft quote (see pricing_calc_lumina.xlsx) and a redlineable SOW (Lumina_SOW_v2.pdf). If it's useful, we can prepare a formal exception request for approval.

Next step: can you confirm target committed token count and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly)?

—Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: pricing_calc_lumina.xlsx (pricing workbook stub); Lumina_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Lumina pricing — request for custom per-token approval (deal LD-2026-1129)

Team — forwarding Lumina's ask. Summary: potential 12-mo commit that scales to ~30B tokens/mo (target), with an immediate ramp over 3 months. Customer is sensitive to per-token economics; procurement asked whether we can put them into a custom band in the $0.00035–0.00045 range.

Why we're asking for an exception:
- Their volume and logoship make them strategically relevant in healthcare vertical (HIPAA-adjacent).
- If we secure a 12-mo commit at midpoint pricing we hit our revenue target for the quarter and open a case study opportunity.

Proposed ask to Pricing/Finance:
- Approve a one-year, volume-committed custom rate at $0.00040/token for tokens above 10B/month, with the first 3 months considered ramp and billed at $0.00045/token.
- Minimum committed spend: $2.5M over 12 months (we've modeled this in the attached).
- Include clause: automatic reversion to rate card pricing if usage drops below 70% of target for 2 consecutive months.

Risks: margin compression in first 6 months, potential for churn if they don't ramp. Mitigations: structured ramp, clause above, and per-route throttles if abused.

Can Finance sign off on the $0.00040 custom band (net of existing list)? If approved, Legal needs to add a short-rate exception appendix to the SOW and Sales Ops must set up the billing schedule.

Thanks — Rafael

Thanks for the clear summary, Rafael. Finance has reviewed the workbook you attached. Recommendation and conditional approval:

- Approve a custom per-token rate of $0.00040 for committed volumes >10B tokens/mo for a 12-month term, contingent on:
  * Signed MSA + SOW within 30 days
  * Minimum committed revenue of $2.5M over 12 months (as modeled)
  * 3-month ramp treated as partial-credit months (we will pay based on actuals with a true-up at month 4)

- We will not approve deeper discounts below $0.00038 unless Sales offers equity, a multi-year commit, or incremental professional services revenue.

Operational notes for Sales Ops / Billing: set up a special pricing plan in Stripe/Billing as "Lumina Health - LD-2026-1129 - Custom Band" with monthly reporting and auto-true-up enabled. Legal should draft a one-paragraph appendix describing rate-card exception and automatic reversion clause.

Marissa: Marissa, given the strategic fit, I'm ok with the concession. Please confirm sign-off on quota credit and commission treatment.

Rafael — please send the final SOW + pricing appendix to Lumina and include the DocuSign link. Finance will review the DocuSign envelope once returned and release the billing plan.

- Sean

Subject: Confirmed: Lumina custom pricing band & next steps (LD-2026-1129)

Hi Emily / Alex — good news: Finance has approved a custom committed band and Legal will add a short appendix to the SOW. Summary of the agreed commercial terms below (for inclusion in the SOW/DocuSign):

- Term: 12 months, effective on signature.
- Committed volumes: target 30B tokens/mo by month 4; 3-month ramp starting at ~8–12B tokens/mo.
- Custom rate: $0.00040 per token for volumes above 10B tokens/month. Ramp months billed at $0.00045/token; true-up at month 4.
- Minimum committed revenue: $2.5M over 12 months.
- Reversion clause: if usage <70% of target for 2 consecutive months, price reverts to standard rate card.
- Billing: monthly in arrears; Sales Ops will create special billing plan and auto-true-up.

I've attached the updated SOW (Lumina_SOW_v2.pdf) and included a DocuSign envelope link here: https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPE/abc123-lumina. Please review and let us know if procurement needs any additional line items (e.g., SOC 2 evidence, data residency notes). Once signed, we'll schedule a kickoff E2E with our Solutions Engineer and CS.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
